name: codeport
description: Know the cost, ship anywhere, stay in control: estimate an idea before you code, pick where to host it, check it for leaked secrets and deploy it to your own cloud.

interface.shortDescription: Hosting cost, where to deploy, security check and deploy
interface.longDescription: Codeport analyzes the app you are building: its stack, its monthly hosting cost on every major platform and the best place to run it. It checks the code for leaked secrets and vulnerable dependencies before you push, follows your organization's guidelines while you code, and deploys to your own Google Cloud or AWS account. Analysis runs on your machine; only the stack profile is sent to Codeport.
defaultPrompt: Where should I host this project, and what will it cost?
